div.head: Cn 1018 2.1
div.ab: Ælc cirice is mid rihte. on cristes agenan griðe. And ælc cristen man ah micele þearfe. þæt he on ðam griðe micele mæðe wite. Forðam godes grið is. ealra griða selost. to geearnianne. 7 geornost to healdenne. 7 þar nihst cynges.

Ælc cirice is mid rihte on Cristes agenan griðe, and ælc Cristen man ah micele þearfe þæt he on ðam griðe micele mæðe wite: forðam Godes grið is ealra griða selost to geearnianne and geornost to healdenne, and þar nihst cynges.

Every church is rightly in Christ's own protection, and it is incumbent upon every Christian man to show great respect for that protection, for the protection of God is of all kinds of protection the most worthy to be obtained, and the most zealously to be upheld, and next to that the protection of the king.

Every church is, by right, under Christ’s own protection, and every Christian has the particular obligation to show great respect for that protection; for of all forms of protection, the best to be sought and the most faithfully to be respected is the protection of God, and after that the king’s.
